trigger: Sam supplied Hudson's public policy.pt, evaluation.json and SHA256SUMS release links during the October 29 ramp/cut-in task.
procedure: Use unchanged hash-gated evaluator and original recovered v02 sources/config. Original seed 520001 smoke twice; only after contract/repeat/acceptance passes, evaluate the original fixed 410001-410020 seeds once. No tuning or retraining.

comparison.exact: All episode fields and summary fields compared; no fields omitted. Integers, booleans, nulls, strings, collection structure and seed identities exact.
comparison.tolerance_scope: Secondary diagnostic on floating-point scalars only; exact equality reported separately. Do not relax tolerances after outcomes.
comparison.failure_policy: Retain all mismatches and failed attempts; original threshold acceptance is separate from numerical agreement.

limits: Original three-lane 60 s fixture with 27 exact-state observations, no communication or steering. No I110 transfer or physical driving acceptance; 60 s nominal ending is not whole-route completion. Record runtime build differences even if metrics match.
